title: Time box
description: One campaign or sprint (EE-186), at operations/time-boxes/<id>.json (route operations/time-box/[id]): a stretch of time a person sets for some of the business's work, with a goal, a start and an end. It is open from `starts` until `ends` unless a person closed or cancelled it first. While it is open, a function workflow whose trigger says `during` its kind is due when it lists the workflow or its function (packages/naive/src/engine/due.ts), and the loop takes `loop_mode` for the workflows it lists (packages/naive/src/engine/loop.ts). Only a person writes it (writer person), because it commits the business's time.

kind.description: campaign: a marketing or sales push toward an audience. sprint: a fixed stretch of building or operating work (Scrum Guide 2020)

goal.description: What the time box is for, in one sentence: the Sprint Goal, or the campaign's objective

ends.description: When it closes on its own; after starts

status.description: active: open between starts and ends. closed: a person ended it, at its end or early. cancelled: a person called it off

functions.description: The functions whose workflows it covers, ids in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json

workflows.description: Workflows it covers by name, `<function>/<workflow>`, as a phase module names them

loop_mode.description: The loop mode for the workflows it covers while it is open. A mode set in naive.config.json for a workflow by name still wins

set_by.description: The person who set loop_mode, and when

owner.description: Who is accountable for the goal, a person or a role id
